title: Latvia will give 100,000 euros to help Nepal
summary_full: On 8th September, the Cabinet of Ministers approved a plan by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to provide EUR 100,000 in humanitarian assistance to Nepal to help mitigate the consequences of the floods.
summary_public: On 8th September, the Cabinet of Ministers approved a plan by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to provide EUR 100,000 in humanitarian assistance to Nepal to help mitigate the consequences of the floods.
